title: ranunculus pyrenaeus subsp. kuepferi
intro: Ranunculus pyrenaeus subsp. kuepferi, commonly known as Pyrenean ranunculus, is a plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus pyrenaeus subsp. kuepferi include soothing and calming effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
